=={{header|Cxc}}==

Cxc ("Corvid") is a language for the Apple ecosystem built around atom lifecycles — functional object-oriented without imperative baggage. Programs are composed of atoms that transition through named phases via guarded dispatch arms. <code>main</code> is itself an atom; its <code>-> running then:</code> block runs once as the atom enters the <code>running</code> phase.

<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
def main:
    use console: Console

    -> running
        then: console.write("Hello world!")
</syntaxhighlight>

<code>Console</code> is the standard capability for text output; <code>use console:</code> grants <code>main</code> explicit access to it. Compile with <code>cxc compile hello-world.cxc out/</code> and run <code>out/hello-world</code>.
